pos = 563
endarc_crc = struct.unpack('<I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
print(f"ENDARC CRC at pos {pos}: {endarc_crc:08x}")

pos += 4
hdr_size_varint = bytearray()
while True:

    hdr_size_varint.append(b)
    pos += 1
    if not (b & 0x80):
        break

hdr_size_len = len(hdr_size_varint)
raw_hdr_size = 0
for i, b in enumerate(hdr_size_varint):
    raw_hdr_size |= (b & 0x7F) << (7 * i)

hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len
print(f"ENDARC hdr_size varint: {bytes(hdr_size_varint).hex()}, raw={raw_hdr_size}, len={hdr_size_len}, total={hdr_size}")

# CRC data starts from the hdr_size varint position
crc_start = pos - hdr_size_len
crc_data = data[crc_start:crc_start+hdr_size]
print(f"ENDARC CRC data ({len(crc_data)} bytes): {crc_data.hex()}")
computed_crc = zlib.crc32(crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
print(f"ENDARC CRC stored: {endarc_crc:08x}, computed: {computed_crc:08x}, match: {endarc_crc == computed_crc}")
